name: Mai-HiME - Unmei no Keitouju
source:
You are Takamura Kyouji, a university undergraduate of archeology (and still in school). By help from Sears Association, you got a temporary teaching intern job at Fuuka Gakuen class 1-3 (Miyu, Natsuki, Mai and Akane's class) teaching History. In reality, you're at Fuuka to research the Hime Legend.

[Edited from [url=http://forums.animesuki.com/showthread.php?p=492171#post492171]Animesuki forums[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演考古学专业的大学生高村恭司。在西亚斯财团的帮助下，你来到风华学园一年三班担任历史科实习教师——深优·葛利亚、玖我夏树、鸨羽舞衣和日暮茜都在这个班级。事实上，你进入风华学园的真正目的，是调查“HiME传说”。

[改编自[url=http://forums.animesuki.com/showthread.php?p=492171#post492171]AnimeSuki论坛[/url]]
